protocol.description: Original concentrated-liquidity AMM. Liquidity providers allocate capital within custom tick ranges; each position is represented as an ERC-721 NFT. Exposes a TWAP oracle consumed by downstream lending protocols. Swap pricing uses the constant-product invariant within tick ranges — no external oracle consumed. Governed by UNI token DAO via Compound Bravo governor + 2-day timelock. Immutable core contracts (no upgrade proxy, no admin key). Deployed independently on 40+ chains; no cross-chain message-passing between deployments.
